data.post: Zwei Stangen veganer Pizza Boereks, im Nebel zusammengeklappt

Excited to try SVGr anew (github .com/smooth-code/svgr)... It seems like a very decent learning tool for the use case here.

And on a side note, walking besides a long straight road a dragonfly crashed its face into a vehicle... Wounded somehow and perhaps even blinded, the beast in flight kept buzzing endlessly, but facing the ground, rubbing it in, with no way out... I was just listening to music (Spor - Aztec) and with my hands and legs shimmering along these fast lanes I started shuffling and stomping, until out of a sudden I have made a hole in the ground.

There's only that many moves a walking person can do with their feet; one that wants to deliver himself to another place at a fast pace.

title: Sant Applause shared a video from the playlist Have You Seen This?
